Package com.csse3200.game.files

Class SaveManager

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.files.SaveManager
public class SaveManager extends Object
Reading, writing and listing save files, one JSON file per fixed slot in the user's home directory (mirrors UserSettings, which stores settings the same way).

Slots live at DECO2800Game/saves/slot_n.json. A slot with no readable file is simply empty; a corrupt file is treated the same way rather than failing the game.

      public static SaveFile newGameSave(int slot)
      The initial contents of a brand-new game: level 1, no recorded player state (the level's defaults apply) and no activated checkpoints. Written as soon as Play creates a game, so the slot shows up on the save-select screen immediately.
      Parameters:
      slot - slot index
      Returns:
      an empty save ready to be written

    • capture

      public static SaveFile capture(int slot, String level, Entity player, List<com.badlogic.gdx.math.GridPoint2> activeCheckpoints)
      Builds a save from the live game state at a checkpoint activation.
      Parameters:
      slot - slot to capture into
      level - current level name ("level1".."boss")
      player - player entity to capture stats from (null-safe)
      activeCheckpoints - positions of activated checkpoints in this level
      Returns:
      a save ready for write(int, com.csse3200.game.files.SaveFile), preserving any previous completion flag
